chapter: Building the band in New York
title: Playing arrangements like heads; what he did as leader
summary: Basie says arrangements get loose when the players start 'painting', and that as leader he mostly pointed out choruses.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
